stem: A population carrying the expected genetic sex markers shows unexpected reproductive expression under stress. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: Genetic sex and observed sex expression are related but environmental and developmental context can affect expression
The markers must always be wrong
Sex expression is determined only by fertilizer concentration
Observed flowers redefine the whole genome
rationale: Cannabis sex has a genetic basis, but observed reproductive expression can show biological plasticity. Genetic information and phenotype should be interpreted together.
